game.title: Titanfall 2
game.blurb: First-person shooter from Respawn Entertainment, published by Electronic Arts, released 2016-10-28. RAWG average playtime: 5 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Campaign
chapters.summary: The story missions with BT, all hidden on Steam. StrategyWiki lists mission pages such as Blood and Rust, Into the Abyss, Effect and Cause, The Beacon, Trial By Fire, The Ark and The Fold Weapon. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: The Pilot's Gauntlet
chapters.summary: Beating the ghost recorder time and climbing the Gauntlet scoreboard.

chapters.title: Titan Combat
chapters.summary: Destroying Titans with each Core ability, executions, multi-kills and collecting all of BT's loadouts.

chapters.title: Pilot Combat
chapters.summary: Wallrunning and sliding kills, rodeo attacks, cloaked takedowns, Stalkers and downing Titans on foot.

chapters.title: Collectibles
chapters.summary: Finding 10, 25 and then all of the campaign collectibles.

chapters.title: Difficulty
chapters.summary: Finishing the campaign on Regular, Hard and Master.

chapters.title: Multiplayer
chapters.summary: Winning a match, customising a loadout and joining a network.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 1237970)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Titanfall_2
Fandom (titanfall.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://titanfall.fandom.com/wiki/Titanfall_2
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Steam app 1237970 ("Titanfall® 2" in the store list and schema) was the only match. StrategyWiki has "Titanfall 2" at completion stage 0. Written subpages: Walkthrough (about 2,500 characters), BT-7274, Blood and Rust, The Pilot's Gauntlet, Gameplay, Weapons, Controls, Pilot Helmets and Achievements and trophies. The mission pages Into the Abyss, Effect and Cause, The Beacon, Trial By Fire, The Ark and The Fold Weapon are linked but not written, and Enemies and Titan Loadouts are not written either, so it was not used; the campaign summary names the mission pages (names only, listed in no particular order because the order was not checked). titanfall.fandom.com answers the API under "Titanfall 2" with about 189 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 21 of 50 Steam achievements are hidden and sit in the campaign chapter; one is named "The Ark", like a StrategyWiki mission page, and two ("The Graduate", "The Real Pilot's Gauntlet") may belong with the Gauntlet. Only 3 achievements are multiplayer.
